body.description: Keep every shape, size, position and the camera angle exactly as drawn; only redraw the surfaces, wood grain, stone, weave, cloth and plants in a careful hand-drawn pixel style. Do not add any object, cloth, sign, lettering or decoration that is not in the drawing. A small beehive pottery kiln: a low round brick wall under a clay dome, a short brick flue at the crown, an arched fire mouth with dim orange embers inside, and two small unfired pots drying on a board. High top-down view on a 2:1 isometric axis. Dark brown 1 pixel outline, muted warm earth colours, 3 to 4 flat tone steps per material, warm light from the upper left, matte, no white or near-white pixels, no gloss, no bevelled plank edges, no text.

note: family round 4: kiln redrawn as a beehive kiln / planters with loose mixed herbs (main session request)
